title: System Integration Advisor
description:
**India T Special Bonus:**  
**Req ID:** 389897
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a System Integration Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Role:** AI Dev Engineer
  
  
Position Details
  

* Role: AI Dev Engineer
* Grade: Grade 10
* Experience Required: 5+ Years

Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled Python Full Stack Developer to join our AI Automation Team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable full stack applications integrated with AI-driven solutions. The role requires strong expertise in backend and frontend development along with hands-on exposure to AI implementation projects and intelligent automation solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be capable of collaborating with QA, Automation, Product, and AI Engineering teams to build innovative AI-enabled platforms and automation solutions for enterprise applications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack applications using Python-based technologies.
* Develop and integrate AI-powered features and automation capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with AI Engineers, QA teams, Product Owners, and Architects to understand business problems and implement technical solutions.
* Build RESTful APIs, backend services, and frontend interfaces for AI-enabled platforms.
* Participate in solution design, technical discussions, and architecture reviews.
* Implement secure, high-performance, and reusable code following best engineering practices.
* Work on AI integration use cases such as intelligent automation, chatbot integration, recommendation engines, predictive analytics, or GenAI-based solutions.
* Perform unit testing, debugging, optimization, and production support activities.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and cloud-based application delivery.
* Ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance of developed applications.

Required Skills Qualifications
  

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python Full Stack Development.
* Strong expertise in Python frameworks such as Flask, FastAPI, or Django.
* Experience in frontend technologies such as React.js, Angular, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Hands-on experience in at least one AI implementation project.
* Experience implementing AI solutions within enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and backend integrations.
* Knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Skills
  

* Experience with Generative AI, LLM integrations, or AI automation frameworks.
* Exposure to AI/ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, or OpenAI APIs.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with automation platforms and intelligent workflow solutions.

Educational Qualification
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Key Competencies
  

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams.
* Solution-oriented mindset with innovation focus.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to adapt to fast-changing AI technologies and business requirements.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. title: Testing Engineering Senior Specialist
description:
**Req ID:** 386519
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Testing Engineering Senior Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Coding Language – Java Primary, Python Good to have
  
  
**API Microservices:** REST APIs, RESTful services, Microservices Architecture, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, API contracts, service integration patterns
  
  
**API Automation:** REST Assured, Cucumber BDD, TestNG, Java, Gradle
  
  
**Framework Architecture:** Reusable automation framework design, modular architecture, custom assertion utilities, schema validation, response comparison, test-data management
  
  
**DevOps:** Jenkins, Udeploy, Git, Bitbucket, CI/CD integration, continuous testing
  
  
**Testing:** API functional testing, integration testing, contract testing, regression testing, legacy-to-modern API parity testing, data validation, negative testing
  
  
**Reporting:** Cucumber Reports, JSON/HTML reporting, execution logs and CI/CD quality reporting
  
  
**AI-Assisted Engineering:** GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted test analysis, scenario generation, Gherkin generation, automation development and coverage analysis
  
  
**Healthcare:** Strong understanding of healthcare enterprise systems and preferably experience with claims, member, provider, eligibility, benefits, authorization, payments, or healthcare interoperability services.
  
  
Experience
  

* 13+ years of overall experience in Quality Engineering, testing, software engineering, or related disciplines.
* 7+ years of strong API testing and automation experience.
* 5+ years in a Test Architect, Solution Architect, QE Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role.

Job Description – API Test Architect Test Solution Lead
  
  
API Modernization | Microservices | Healthcare | Quality Engineering
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced API Test Architect Solution Lead to lead the quality engineering strategy, architecture, and implementation for large-scale API modernization and microservices transformation programs within the healthcare domain.
  
  
The role will be responsible for defining the end-to-end API testing architecture and modernization validation strategy for enterprise services being transformed from legacy/monolithic platforms into modern RESTful APIs and microservices.
  
  
This is a customer-facing technical leadership role requiring strong expertise in API testing, test automation architecture, microservices, legacy-to-modern API parity validation, CI/CD integration, healthcare data validation, and AI-assisted Quality Engineering.
  
  
The Solution Lead will work closely with enterprise architects, API developers, product owners, business teams, DevOps teams, and QA engineering teams to ensure modernized services meet functional, integration, data integrity, performance, security, and release-readiness requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
API Test Architecture Solutioning
  

* Define the enterprise API Quality Engineering architecture, strategy, standards, and implementation roadmap for API modernization programs.
* Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks supporting hundreds of APIs and thousands of test scenarios.
* Establish standardized testing approaches using Cucumber, TestNG, REST Assured, Gradle, Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/Udeploy, and automated reporting.
* Define framework architecture with clear separation of:
* Test data
* Test logic
* Configuration
* Validation utilities
* Reporting
* Environment management
* Build reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and common validation capabilities that can be adopted across multiple projects.
* Establish traceability across requirements → feature files → test data → automated execution → defects → results.

API Modernization Microservices Validation
  

* Lead testing strategy for migration of legacy enterprise services to REST APIs and microservices architecture.
* Define legacy-versus-modernized service parity testing to ensure business functionality and data behavior remain consistent during modernization.
* Establish baseline request/response datasets from legacy services and compare them against modernized API responses.
* Design automated comparison capabilities for:
* Request/response validation
* JSON/XML payload comparison
* Schema validation
* Field-level comparison
* Business-rule validation
* Data transformation validation
* Database/backend validation
* Error and exception handling
* Validate service decomposition and interactions across distributed microservices.
* Develop testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous service integrations.
* Define regression strategies that allow modernization teams to continuously verify functional parity during incremental migration.

API Functional Integration Testing
  

* Define comprehensive API testing coverage including:
* Functional testing
* Integration testing
* Contract testing
* Schema validation
* Positive and negative testing
* Boundary testing
* Authentication and authorization validation
* Error handling
* Data integrity validation
* Regression testing
* End-to-end service validation
* Establish API test scenarios based on OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL schemas, interface contracts, business requirements, and legacy system documentation.
* Define reusable test-data strategies using Excel, generated datasets, synthetic data, and approved production-like samples.
* Drive automation-first testing while identifying scenarios requiring specialized or exploratory validation.

Healthcare Domain Validation
  

* Provide Quality Engineering leadership for healthcare enterprise services supporting areas such as:
* Member and eligibility
* Provider
* Claims
* Benefits
* Enrollment
* Accumulators
* Authorization
* Payments
* Clinical and administrative integrations
* Ensure modernization testing validates critical healthcare business rules and cross-system data integrity.
* Support testing of healthcare interoperability and data exchange services where applicable, including FHIR/HL7-based APIs and healthcare integration patterns.
* Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare test data and alignment with organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Automation Framework Engineering
  

* Architect and enhance BDD-based API automation frameworks using:
* Cucumber
* TestNG
* REST Assured
* Java
* Gradle
* Define reusable feature files, step definitions, API clients, assertion libraries, data utilities, and comparison utilities.
* Develop configurable validation mechanisms capable of supporting different APIs without extensive custom coding.
* Establish coding standards, framework governance, peer reviews, and reusable engineering patterns.
* Optimize automation suites for parallel execution, maintainability, stability, and faster regression cycles.

CI/CD DevOps Integration
  

* Integrate API automation into Jenkins/Udeploy CI/CD pipelines.
* Define automated quality gates for builds and deployments.
* Enable API regression suites to execute across development, QA, integration, staging, and release environments.
* Establish mechanisms for:
* Pipeline-triggered execution
* Environment configuration
* Test-data management
* Parallel execution
* Failure diagnostics
* Automated reporting
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to enable continuous testing and shift-left quality engineering.

Reporting Quality Metrics
  

* Define enterprise-level API Quality Engineering reporting using:
* Cucumber Reports
* JSON Reports
* HTML Reports
* Execution Logs
* CI/CD dashboards
* Establish metrics for:
* API automation coverage
* Functional coverage
* Regression coverage
* Pass/fail trends
* Defect leakage
* Modernization parity
* Execution stability
* Release readiness
* Provide technical insights and quality recommendations to engineering leadership and customer stakeholders.

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering
  

* Drive adoption of GitHub Copilot and GenAI-assisted engineering across the API testing lifecycle.
* Use AI assistance for:
* Requirement and API specification analysis
* Test scenario generation
* Test case generation
* Gherkin/feature-file generation
* REST Assured automation development
* Code refactoring
* Test-data generation
* Coverage-gap identification
* Failure analysis
* Leverage OpenAPI specifications, GraphQL schemas, legacy documentation, and existing test assets as inputs for AI-assisted test design.
* Define appropriate human review and governance practices for AI-generated test assets.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through intelligent automation and reusable accelerators.

Technical Leadership Customer Engagement
  

* Act as the technical solution lead and architecture point of contact for API Quality Engineering.
* Engage with customer stakeholders to understand modernization objectives, current-state architecture, quality risks, and target-state requirements.
* Translate business and technical requirements into testing architecture, solution approach, implementation roadmap, effort estimates, and delivery plans.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical solution presentations with customers and engineering leadership.
* Lead technical discussions across development, architecture, DevOps, business, and QA teams.
* Mentor automation engineers and QA leads and provide technical direction across distributed teams.
* Identify testing risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and mitigation strategies early in the modernization lifecycle.

Required Technical Skills
  
  
**API Microservices:** REST APIs, RESTful services, Microservices Architecture, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, API contracts, service integration patterns
  
  
**API Automation:** REST Assured, Cucumber BDD, TestNG, Java, Gradle
  
  
**Framework Architecture:** Reusable automation framework design, modular architecture, custom assertion utilities, schema validation, response comparison, test-data management
  
  
**DevOps:** Jenkins, Udeploy, Git, Bitbucket, CI/CD integration, continuous testing
  
  
**Testing:** API functional testing, integration testing, contract testing, regression testing, legacy-to-modern API parity testing, data validation, negative testing
  
  
**Reporting:** Cucumber Reports, JSON/HTML reporting, execution logs and CI/CD quality reporting
  
  
**AI-Assisted Engineering:** GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted test analysis, scenario generation, Gherkin generation, automation development and coverage analysis
  
  
**Healthcare:** Strong understanding of healthcare enterprise systems and preferably experience with claims, member, provider, eligibility, benefits, authorization, payments, or healthcare interoperability services.
  
  
Preferred Skills
  

* Experience leading enterprise API modernization or monolith-to-microservices transformation programs.
* Experience architecting API automation frameworks used across multiple applications or programs.
* Experience with legacy-to-modern service comparison/parity validation.
* Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, containers, Kubernetes, API gateways, and service discovery is desirable.
* Exposure to service virtualization, mocking, contract testing, and API performance testing.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7 is advantageous.
* Experience implementing AI/GenAI-assisted Quality Engineering practices.
* Strong customer-facing solutioning, architecture presentation, estimation, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

Experience
  

* 13+ years of overall experience in Quality Engineering, testing, software engineering, or related disciplines.
* 7+ years of strong API testing and automation experience.
* 5+ years in a Test Architect, Solution Architect, QE Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex API modernization, microservices, integration, or digital transformation programs.
* Prior experience in healthcare or health insurance programs is strongly preferred.

Expected Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate should be able to take an enterprise modernization requirement such as:
  
  
Legacy Enterprise Services → Modern APIs → Microservices
  
  
**and independently define the corresponding:**  
Current-State Assessment → Test Strategy → API Test Architecture → Legacy Baseline → Modern API Validation → Automated Parity Testing → CI/CD Integration → Regression Strategy → Quality Gates → Production Readiness
  
  
The candidate should combine hands-on API automation architecture expertise with solutioning and customer-facing leadership, rather than functioning only as a test manager or delivery manager.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. title: Backend Developer
description:
Backend Developer

**Company:** AppNexus Technology Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** B114 First floor Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–4 Years

About the Role

AppNexus Technology Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled **Backend Developer** to join our development team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable backend applications and APIs for web and mobile platforms.

You will work on projects across **FinTech, Digital Banking, ERP, Healthcare, Education, E\-commerce, Logistics, and other business applications**, AI \& Cloud who can develop scalable collaborating with frontend, mobile, UI/UX, and project teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain robust backend applications using cloud Ai and Chatgpt **PHP and Laravel**.
* Build secure and scalable **REST APIs** for web and mobile applications.
* Design and manage databases using **MySQL/PostgreSQL**.
* Implement authentication, authorization, **RBAC**, and API security.
* Integrate third\-party services, payment gateways, SMS, email, OTP, maps, and other APIs.
* Develop business logic, database structures, and backend workflows.
* Optimize application performance, database queries, and API response times.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve backend issues.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Work with Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Coordinate with frontend and Flutter developers for API integration.
* Deploy and maintain applications on **Linux/AWS/VPS/CloudPanel** environments.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and production releases.
* Understand project requirements and convert them into technical solutions.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **phyton and**  **Laravel**.
* Good understanding of **MySQL/PostgreSQL**.
* Experience in developing **RESTful APIs**.
* Strong understanding of MVC architecture and OOP concepts.
* Knowledge of authentication methods such as JWT/OAuth/token\-based authentication.
* Experience with Git/GitHub.
* Good understanding of database design, relationships, indexing, and query optimization.
* Basic knowledge of Linux server environments and deployment.
* Understanding of JSON, API integrations, and third\-party services.
* Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical problems independently.

Good to Have

* Experience with **Redis, queues, cron jobs, and caching**.
* Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.
* Experience integrating payment gateways and financial APIs.
* Knowledge of Docker.
* Experience with Flutter/mobile application backend integration.
* Experience working on FinTech, ERP, e\-commerce, or SaaS platforms.
* Knowledge of microservices or multi\-tenant architecture.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong programming and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.
* Candidates who can independently handle backend modules and API development are preferred.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
